bio_en: Garegin Sargisbekian, known as Machkal, was a native of Yerevan who joined the ARF early. In the First World War he served in Dro's volunteer regiment advancing toward Vaspurakan, and under the Republic of Armenia he was a company commander (hariurapet) in the new army. In emigration he ran a dairy in Lovaliere near Metz, France. He died suddenly there in November 1953, aged about 60-62, on the night the ARF Day was being celebrated in Paris.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Age given as 60-62, so birth c.1891-93 (not stated).
